subject: FincoBank — audit logs & data access evidence request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@fincobank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: FincoBank — audit logs & data access follow-up (recap + next steps)

Sam — thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery call and next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of asks:
- FincoBank needs audit evidence showing who accessed customer PII (which fields, who, when, and from which IP/location).
- Export format that your compliance team can ingest (CSV preferred) with field mapping.
- Retention policy details (how long logs are retained and how to request historical exports).
- Data residency confirmation: primary logs stored in us-east-1 and exported data handling.
- SOC 2 / access-review evidence for the period Jan 1 — Mar 31, 2026.

What Redwood will provide by next steps:
1) Sample audit export (CSV) with columns we discussed and hashed PII where appropriate — see attached example_audit_export.csv stub.
2) Audit logs spec doc describing available fields, export timestamps, and retention policy — attached (redwood_audit_logs_spec_v1.pdf).
3) Short note on how we map internal user IDs to customer usernames (we will provide mapping process and a pseudonymization option).
4) SOC 2 evidence pointer: we will share the SOC 2 report link and provide a short extract of access-review logs for the requested quarter.

Requested from FincoBank:
- Confirmation of the exact fields you need in the CSV (if any PII must be left unhashed for internal purposes).
- Any additional formatting requirements for your ingestion (date format, timezone, delimiter).
- Email address for secure transfer of the export (SFTP or secure upload preferred).

Tentative timeline:
- By EOD Apr 6: sample CSV + audit spec doc (attached).
- By Apr 9: SOC 2 extract and any additional evidence we can provide for Q1.

Please confirm and let us know if Maya (cc’ed) should be primary recipient for the export.

Thanks —
Marissa
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood_audit_logs_spec_v1.pdf (PDF, ~210KB)]
[Attachment: example_audit_export.csv (CSV, stub)]

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@fincobank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Chen <maya.chen@fincobank.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-02T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FincoBank — audit logs & data access follow-up (recap + next steps)

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

Required CSV fields (preferred order):
- customer_id (UUID)
- internal_user_id (redwood ID)
- username/email (PII) — ideally hashed unless we can map on our side
- action (read/write/export/delete)
- resource_type (document/model/prompt)
- resource_id
- timestamp (ISO 8601, UTC)
- source_ip
- region (us-east-1 / eu-west-1)
- session_id
- note (free text)

On hashing PII: Our compliance team prefers that PII be pseudonymized by default. We can provide a salt if needed for matching. If you can provide both hashed and raw export under strict access controls, that would be ideal — otherwise hashed is acceptable.

Retention: We must show proof that audit logs are retained for at least 90 days and that exports older than that can be retrieved on request (with any cost/lead time noted).

Data residency: FincoBank requires that log storage and exports for production traffic remain in us-east-1. Can you confirm that both real-time logs and any historical archives tied to the account are stored and exported from us-east-1 only?

SOC 2: for the Q1 window we need the access reviewer logs showing which Redwood staff accessed customer logs or production systems (who, role, reason, timestamp). A redacted extract is fine as long as it includes the fields above.

Delivery: prefer secure SFTP to sftp.fincobank.com (will set up credentials) or a signed pre-auth link. Please don’t send raw CSV to regular email.

Maya will own compliance ingestion — cc’d. Looking forward to the sample export.

—Sam
Sam Patel
Director, InfoSec — FincoBank
sam.patel@fincobank.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@fincobank.com>, Maya Chen <maya.chen@fincobank.com>
Date: 2026-04-02T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FincoBank — audit logs & data access follow-up (recap + next steps)

Marissa / Sam — quick internal note before we produce the sample: 

We can generate the CSV from the admin export tool with the fields Sam listed. A few implementation notes:
- We will pseudonymize username/email by default (SHA-256 + per-deal salt) and can provide a separate raw export under a signed request with a formal MA/POA and a short retention window.
- Audit logs are stored in primary region us-east-1 for FincoBank production. Backups/archives are also in us-east-1; we do not replicate production logs to eu regions unless explicitly configured.
- Retention policy: default 90 days for detailed event logs; we can enable extended retention (365 days) for enterprise accounts with a retention add-on. Retrieval of archived exports for >90 days may incur a 2–3 business day retrieval window depending on size.
- SOC 2: we can provide a redacted access review extract (who/role/timestamp/reason). The SOC 2 report is available via our customer portal; I’ll include a link in the package.

I’ve attached a small sample export stub (example_audit_export.csv) with hashed_email column for your review.

Next step: Marissa, I’ll pull a full sample export scoped to the FincoBank prod account and stage it to an S3 pre-signed URL (or SFTP) once Sam confirms delivery method.

-Aditya
Product Security — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
[Attachment: example_audit_export.csv (CSV, 12KB, stub)]

From: Maya Chen <maya.chen@fincobank.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@fincobank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-03T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FincoBank — audit logs & data access follow-up (recap + next steps)

Thanks — this looks good. Two quick items from compliance: 
1) Please include a column that indicates whether the event included PII (boolean). That helps our pipeline triage exports.
2) For SOC 2 extracts, we will need a statement on whether any Redwood employees accessed FincoBank production logs in the period Jan 1 — Mar 31, 2026 and, if so, what the approved justification categories were. Redacted user IDs are OK, but we need role and justification text.

Delivery method: we will accept an S3 pre-signed URL (one-time use, expires 72 hours) or SFTP. Please coordinate credentials with our platform team — I’ll share the SFTP endpoint and expected username via secure channel.

If you can deliver the sample by EOD Apr 6 as proposed, we’ll aim to complete ingestion validation by Apr 13.

—Maya
Senior Manager, Compliance — FincoBank
maya.chen@fincobank.com
